checks.variant: variant_scale multiplies the seeded random vector v that builds the right-hand side b = A @ v by 1.000000000000001 (about five binary64 ulps applied uniformly); the seed, the operator, the hierarchy and the iteration count stay fixed.

checks.variant: identical graded output, measured: A.data[0] (after the seeded imaginary perturbation is added) is multiplied by 1.000000000000001 and the graded aggregate map is unchanged, for the same discreteness reason as aggregate-real. The variant supplies no calibration evidence for this check; the altbuild floor is the sensitivity evidence a reviewer reads instead.
checks.altbuild: the same pinned source with the pybind11/C++ core compiled -O0 instead of the pinned optimized build (meson-python -Csetup-args=-Doptimization=0; verified in the build tree's compile_commands.json, falls back to CXXFLAGS=-O0 if meson-python drops the setup-arg)

checks.name: aggregate-pairwise-real
checks.variant: identical graded output, measured: A.data[0] is multiplied by 1.000000000000001 and the graded aggregate map is unchanged -- pairwise matching decisions are threshold comparisons on classical strength values and are insensitive to a single few-ulp perturbation. The variant supplies no calibration evidence for this check; the altbuild floor is the sensitivity evidence a reviewer reads instead.
checks.altbuild: the same pinned source with the pybind11/C++ core compiled -O0 instead of the pinned optimized build (meson-python -Csetup-args=-Doptimization=0; verified in the build tree's compile_commands.json, falls back to CXXFLAGS=-O0 if meson-python drops the setup-arg)

checks.name: aggregate-real
checks.variant: identical graded output, measured: A.data[0] (the first stored matrix entry) is multiplied by 1.000000000000001, so the two input files differ byte-wise, but standard_aggregation and naive_aggregation return a discrete 0/1 aggregate map and that single few-ulp perturbation moves no row's relative-strength threshold on the airfoil mesh. The variant therefore supplies no calibration evidence for this check; the altbuild floor is the sensitivity evidence a reviewer reads instead.
checks.altbuild: the same pinned source with the pybind11/C++ core compiled -O0 instead of the pinned optimized build (meson-python -Csetup-args=-Doptimization=0; verified in the build tree's compile_commands.json, falls back to CXXFLAGS=-O0 if meson-python drops the setup-arg)
